date_semantics.domain: Valid proleptic Gregorian dates in years 1 through 9999
excludes: Which date a legal provision intends
date_semantics.proposition: Ordinal day counts, lexicographic date triples and the bounded integer date rank have the same strict order. Year transitions have 365 or 366 days under the Gregorian leap rule.
date_semantics.trust_boundary: Independent Python parser and production codecs are tested separately; this theorem defines integer calendar semantics, not string-library or compiler correctness.
